newsitem.title: USA: United Cities gets Illinois rate increase.
newsitem.headline: United Cities gets Illinois rate increase.

text.p: United Cities Gas Co said Thursday that the Illinois Commerce Commission has granted the company a rate increase of $428,000 in annual revenues.

The company said an overall increase of 2.09 percent was granted for approximately 23,000 customers in or near Harrisburg, Metropolis, Vandalia, Virden and Salem, Ill, as a result of an application filed before the Commission in November 1996.
The rate increase, said the company, will be followed by a three year rate moratorium.
United Cities Gas Company distributes natural and propane gas to approximately 350,000 customers in 10 states.
